title: "AMBER"
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
execute: 
  echo: false
html-table-processing: none
---


```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("_setup.R"))
box::use(
  amber_qc = amber/qc,
  amber_roh = amber/roh,
)
tool <- "amber"
dat$data <- dat$data |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(tool, .data$tool_parser))
```

## QC

```{r}
#| label: amber_qc
tbl_nm <- "amber_qc"
d <- dat$data |>
  tw_utils$unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
amber_qc$gt_tab(d, dat$schemas)
```

## Consanguinity

```{r}
#| label: amber_homozygousregion
#| layout-nrow: 1
tbl_nm <- "amber_homozygousregion"
d <- dat$data |>
  tw_utils$unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
description <- paste(
  "Continuous regions of homozygosity (ROH).",
  "minLength: min ROH length 5 Mb;",
  "maxHetProportion: max proportion of heterozygous variants in ROH 0.05;"
)
tabs <- d$res |>
  amber_roh$gt_tab()
tabs$tab2
tabs$tab1
```
